name: visual-explainer
description: Generate beautiful HTML pages for diagrams, diff reviews, plan reviews, slides, and data tables

interface.longDescription: Create styled HTML diagrams, comparisons, code and plan reviews, visual explanations, and slide decks from your conversation and available source files. Bundles the Visual Explainer renderer, design guides, and templates. Uses host file and execution tools; no hosted server or in-chat app view.
